# [CS028] JWT Signing Algorithm Not Enforced (jwt-missing-alg-check)

A JWT is verified without restricting the signing algorithm.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-347](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/347.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

If the key function does not check the algorithm, a token signed with HS256 using the public RSA key as HMAC secret can pass verification (algorithm confusion).

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
token, err := jwt.Parse(raw, func(t *jwt.Token) (any, error) { return publicKey, nil })
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
token, err := jwt.Parse(raw, func(t *jwt.Token) (any, error) { return publicKey, nil },
	jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"RS256"}))
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [jwt-missing-alg-check]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    jwt-missing-alg-check: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore jwt-missing-alg-check -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** jwt-missing-alg-check
```
